svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both covers are 440 mm wide (the gap between the rails).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear cover: a half round, 41 mm mean radius, 129 mm of sheet. Roll it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round a 80 mm bar. It wraps the back of the rear roller.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front cover: 41 mm mean radius, 102 degrees of arc (73 mm of sheet),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from straight below the front roller round to 12 degrees above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each cover has a 15 mm tab bent out flat at each end; the tabs lie on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rails' inside walls, one M5 screw each into a rivet nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 14 mm or more from the belt all round; the rear cover guards the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rear roller, the front cover the in-running nip under the front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the belt turns by hand without touching either cover.
